NPI Registry (CMS) API - taxonomy queries for ZIP 08854 (chiropractor, acupuncturist, optometrist) plus name queries
BestProsInTown Piscataway directory (town hub + category pages)
Birdeye category and business pages (chiropractors, wellness, Chief Barber Shop)

Own business websites opened directly (icare4smiles, smilewellness, ohmdentalpiscataway, affordablefamilydentistrynj, radiantorthonj, smilegarden, nuvasmile, in-focusvision, ambroseanimalhospital, maxhealthnj, cassatone, dinasnj, bodybackinaction, getsnatchedaesthetics, calpelli/capellihairsalonllc, fit4blast, sonovi, healthydisc, ampphysicaltherapy, newuphysicaltherapy, the-eye-center, islandspasauna)

BBB profiles (Piscataway Family Dental, Island Spa & Sauna, New U Physical Therapy)

categories_thin: Yoga/pilates: only Art of Living of New Jersey looks independent; Club Pilates and HOTWORX at 1642 Stelton Rd are franchises. No independent yoga or pilates studio surfaced in map or directory searches.
Day spas (non-medical): only LUXE Wellness Spa and Cassatone Massage Therapy are independents; Hand & Stone is a franchise and the remaining listings are nail salons.

Therapists/counseling: Piscataway listings are dominated by solo telehealth LCSWs/LPCs on Psychology Today plus chain clinics (LifeStance affiliate, Ellie Mental Health, Handspring). Perspectives Counseling Center is the only group practice with a physical Piscataway office found.
Optical retail: no independent eyewear-only shop surfaced; eyewear is sold inside the two optometry practices, and the third practice (Eye Tek) sells through its office.

Eye care and acupuncture were thinnest in the first pass and have now been expanded: optometry went from 2 to 3 practices (In Focus, The Eye Center, Eye Tek) using the NPI registry, and acupuncture from 1 to 3 (365 Acupuncture, Shore Points Wellness, Maximum Health & Wellness), which is probably close to complete for a township this size.

371 Hoes Ln Suite 200 is a suite-rental building: KB Luxe, Defined Look, Cassatone, Kingdom Chiropractic, Perspectives, J'Ariae, Snatched Aesthetics and Fit4Blast are known tenants, but the building almost certainly houses more one-person beauty/wellness studios that no public source lists suite-by-suite.
caveats: CHAIN RULE APPLIED CONSISTENTLY: a business is excluded if it is a national chain or franchise, a hospital/health-system practice, or a branded multi-site operation with roughly 10+ locations; owner-operated groups of up to about 9 sites are kept with an explicit chain note. Under this rule AmeriCare Physical Therapy (now part of Ivy Rehab), Trinity Rehab (24 NJ clinics), SportsCare Physical Therapy (57 NJ clinics) and True Cuts Barbershop (3-location NJ brand, also in New Brunswick not Piscataway) were removed in this revision; Piscataway Animal Clinic (4-site local group), Maximum Health & Wellness (6 NJ sites), The Eye Center (3 offices), New U Physical Therapy (2 sites) and Certified Dermatology were kept with notes. Satori Academy (8 NJ sites) is kept as an explicitly flagged borderline brand network.

HOSPITAL-SYSTEM PRACTICES EXCLUDED CONSISTENTLY: HMH Primary Care - Piscataway, Saint Peter's Physician Associates (1636 Stelton Rd #301), Hackensack Meridian Rehabilitation and - removed in this revision - Piscataway Dunellen Family Practice at 24 Stelton Rd Suite A, which Healthgrades lists as 'RWJPE Piscataway Dunellen Family Practice' (RWJ Physician Enterprise / RWJBarnabas).

Other verified present and excluded as chains/franchises: Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa (1292 Centennial Ave), Ivy Rehab Physical Therapy (1630 Stelton Rd #209), 24 Hour Fitness (1327 Centennial Ave), HOTWORX (1642 Stelton Rd #401), Club Pilates (1642 Stelton Rd #416), Kessler Rehabilitation Center (220 Centennial Ave and 250 Old New Brunswick Rd), NJBH/LifeStance (371 Hoes Ln Ste 106), Ellie Mental Health (242 Old New Brunswick Rd #145), Great Clips (4917 Stelton Rd, South Plainfield), plus the YMCA at the Piscataway Community Center (municipal/nonprofit facility).

Provider-level listings were merged into the practice they belong to rather than counted as separate businesses: Dr. Ayesha Muzaffar into iCare4Smiles; Dr. Martin Marks into Dental Cosmetic Center of Piscataway; Justin Schaefers, OD into The Eye Center of Piscataway; Dr. Andrew/Thomas Campana into Campana Chiropractic; Dr. Shana Shoulson was in the removed Dunellen practice entry.

The former 'Flow Acupuncture' entry at 80 Kingsbridge Rd #1 was removed as unsourced; the tenant at that suite is Maximum Health & Wellness Piscataway LLC per its own locations page and the NPI registry. Lissah.Nails (542 Longfellow Ave) was removed because Longfellow Ave is a residential street and the only evidence was aggregator listings.

Several suites share addresses (371 Hoes Ln Suite 200; 1630 Stelton Rd Ste 201; 1100 Centennial Ave Ste 101/202/204; 1621 Stelton Rd; 154 Stelton Rd). Duplicate-looking entries are flagged in notes; the triage team should merge any that are the same practice.

Piscataway is a large, spread-out township with several retail nodes (Stelton Rd, Centennial Ave, Hoes Ln, S Washington Ave, Rutgers-adjacent). Coverage remains best around Stelton Rd/Centennial Ave; the Rutgers/New Brunswick border edge may hide businesses addressed as New Brunswick.

Google Maps returned only a limited view of 4-8 results per query in the research browser session, so Google was used as a cross-check, not a census. Bing Maps caps at about 12 results per query ranked by proximity.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API and mirrors were unreachable in the earlier pass and were not retried in this revision; OSM was not usable as a census.

YellowPages, Superpages, Yelp, Manta, find-open, Cylex and Opendi return HTTP 403/Cloudflare blocks to direct fetches from this environment; several of those listings (Freddie's, Shore Points Wellness, Heights Haircutters, Audiology Hearing Health) are therefore cited from search results rather than opened pages.

Madelyne Latorre, OD: aggregator NPI profiles place her at In Focus Vision Center's building (1100 Centennial Ave, Suite 102, same phone) but she is not on the practice's current doctor roster and the NPI registry optometrist query for ZIP 08854 does not return her, so she was not added as a separate practice. Confirm with the practice before treating her as a distinct business.

Ambrose Animal Hospital: street address unverified - the site renders address/hours dynamically and no fetched page states the street address; 1636 Stelton Rd Suite 312 comes only from directory snippets.
Freddie's Barber Shop (147 Stelton Rd) may be closed; only directory data was available.
Snatched Aesthetics publishes three different addresses (31 Stelton Rd Suite 7 in its contact block, 371 Hoes Ln Suite E7 in its page title, 371 Hoes Ln Suite E8 in directories).
Shore Points Wellness (154 Stelton Rd): name/address link to the 'Shore Points Acupuncture' website is unconfirmed; the suite building houses several practices.

Phone numbers are Unknown for several directory-only entries (anupamaa, LaBella Hair Extensions, Brothers Barber, House of Blades II, KB Luxe, Defined Look, Lysscoley Nails) - the accessible directories did not publish them.
Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce directory (mcrcc.org) was not browsed member-by-member, so chamber-member businesses in group B may still be missing.
Piscataway Township does not publish a public list of licensed beauty/barber establishments - the Clerk's Office only issues an application form - so that official census route is closed.
